mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) indicates stronger economic activity, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1's increase is not sustained over the next 5 days or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.0% in the next month
failure_condition: If UNRATE crosses above 5.0% but returns are positive, or if it doesn't cross but returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in personal consumption (GDPC1) and rise in supply (INDPRO) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases AND INDPRO increases over the next month
failure_condition: If both proxies increase but returns are negative, or if one increases while the other doesn't.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) amplifies market optimism, leading to significantly higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the regime isn't late-cycle expansion but FEDFUNDS declines, returns are not sufficiently positive.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in new job additions (PAYEMS) exceeding 1.5 million (1500 in the series) signals strong labor market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS exceeds 1500 but returns are negative, or if it doesn't exceed but returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising personal consumption (GDPC1) and new job growth (PAYEMS) above their 5-month moving averages signals robust economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both proxies meet thresholds but returns are negative, or if one meets and the other doesn't.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side inflationary pressure regime, a sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) above 105.0 (its 5-month average) signals potential easing of inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the regime isn't supply-side inflation but INDPRO increases, returns are not positive.
